tasks.title: Founder answers v1, written alone and sealed
tasks.why: D1-02 opens this envelope, and there is no second pass, so v1 is the only version the workshop has.
instructions: Write one page on your own device under seven headings: (1) Sway in one sentence, as you would say it to a stranger; (2) the customer problem that matters most, naming the customer and the moment; (3) why a customer would choose Sway over doing nothing; (4) ambitions, constraints and biggest doubts, three short lists; (5) what the other founder may see differently, in your words; (6) what evidence would change my mind, as observations with numbers where you can; (7) the five hardest calls, one line each with reasoning and what would change my mind. (45 min)

The five hardest calls are: (a) hero mechanic: Sway Pass, Sway Link, or a card sent into the chat with the Pass second; (b) the single-player value sentence: what one person gets on day one with nobody else on it; (c) who pays first and when brands enter: consumer-first alone, consumer-first with two named design-partner brands as unpaid observers, or a paid discovery study as the first offer; (d) money shown or hidden in the first cohort: earnings label on or off by default, the disclosure line present either way; (e) founder commitment: hours per week now, the trigger and date for one founder going full time, and who owns product, pilot recruitment, commercial outreach, operations and fundraising.
Label every claim FOUNDER DECISION, HYPOTHESIS or OPEN QUESTION; do not edit after saving; do not read the other's. (10 min)
Keep the file off the shared drive; add `01_answers/blake_v1_receipt.md` reading: written Mon 5 Oct, one page, seven headings, sealed. (5 min)
Work alone, with no messages about the content. This is the independent strategic thinking block and it happens once.
tasks.output: One page on Blake's own device, sealed until D1-02, with the receipt in `01_answers/`.
tasks.fallback: Written on Tue 6 Oct at the cost of the alternative desk test. Still missing on Fri 9 Oct: six minutes of in-room writing at D1-02, which is the only recovery left.

tasks.title: Technical window A: accounts, project, hello-world and the scan
tasks.why: Window A proves the tool chain and the scan, and it gates window B on Wednesday.
instructions: Run checks A1 to A5 in order; A4 does not start until A3 passes. If the Supabase connection fails twice, switch to the tool's own built-in backend and note it in `access_note.md` rather than spending the evening on it.

A1 Accounts (10 min): create or log in to Lovable (Pro), Supabase and GitHub, all on a personal email; confirm the plan and credit figures on the checkout page. Pass: logged in to all three, plan and credits written down.
A2 Database (10 min): Supabase project `sway-proto`; copy the project URL and the anon key's location (Settings, API) into `04_prototype/access_note.md`. Pass: the project shows Active.

A3 Build project (15 min): Lovable project `sway-proto` connected to the Supabase project, with GitHub sync to a private repo. Pass: Supabase shows connected and the repo exists. This check gates everything after it.

A4 Hello-world with QR (35 min): prompt: Create a mobile-first page at /hello that says Sway hello with the current time, and a page at /qr that shows a QR code (qrcode.react, SVG, 240px) encoding the public URL of /hello. Insert one row into a table called hello_events each time /hello loads and show the count on the page. Then publish. Pass: the published /qr scanned by an iPhone camera and an Android camera opens /hello over mobile data with Wi-Fi off, and the count rises on refresh.

A5 Two-way scan and paper QR (20 min): /qr on the laptop and on one phone, each scanned from the other phone, both directions; note distance and brightness; print one A4 paper QR for the travel folder; send Tori the published URL and a photo of /qr and ask her to open it over mobile data. Pass: both scans inside 5 seconds, the paper QR scans, and Tori reports opened.
The published URL and the line that the scan worked are the two things that must be in `readiness.md` part 1.
tasks.output: `05_logistics/readiness.md` part 1 with the published URL and the scan result, plus `04_prototype/access_note.md`.
tasks.fallback: A1: if Pro checkout fails, stay free for hello-world and upgrade on Wed 7 Oct before window B. A3: if it fails twice, switch to the tool's own built-in backend (Lovable Cloud) and note it in `access_note.md`. A4: if the count stays static, prompt allow anonymous inserts on hello_events; if the QR is blank, use the api.qrserver.com image fallback. A5: take the QR to 300 px and brightness to maximum, and get Tori's check by message before 22:00 UK. Never cut. If the evening slips to Wed 7 Oct it pushes window B into Thu 8 Oct, which costs Blake the product pack.
